headline: Master b130228ee is healthy where merges happen. The required checks are green and readiness is VERIFIED (run 38266204232). The budgeted-autonomy workstream has merged all five PRs and meets 34 of 36 card acceptance criteria; the remaining gap is the PR 5 live run through Codex and Cursor, which only the owner can launch. The wider project is far from its end states: 5 of 41 completion-roadmap exit criteria are done by code check, 1 of 5 dogfood unlock criteria is met with 0 of the 7 needed 3a rows landed, and the next release has not started (0 of 9 runbook pre-tag steps, compat-gate red since 2026-09-12). This phase merged PR 5 (#781) and the pilot fixes (#780), and built the phase-end validation and audit (#783: CLEAN, all five required checks green, not yet merged).

areas.name: Product roadmap
areas.done_means:
No single definition exists. Three end states compete:
- The 2026-09-05 completion roadmap (docs/audits/2026-09-completion-roadmap.md). Its M1-M6 exits end in a 0.2.0 public launch and a first enterprise customer on autonomous Tier 0, with M7 after that.
- The 2026-09-19 product-boundary lock (docs/marketing/product-boundary.md). Its end state is the governed-behavior core, with autonomy, Forge, Cloud PAYG and Learn on HOLD.
- The commercial exits in ProductsAndBusinessPlan.md §5.3 and ProductFleetImplementationRoadmap.md: 3-5 paying orgs.
docs/DocsIndex.md marks none of the three as live or historical. This area is scored against the completion roadmap's 41 numbered exit checkboxes, the only countable list, and also against the product-boundary core list.
areas.status:
Built on master is the governed-behavior core that the 2026-09-19 lock calls the product:
- the init/verify/gates/run loop with Ed25519 operator keys and a signed ledger;
- certified .ashpkg packages with publish, pull and share, and hub-less /mesh/v1 federation;
- export native, aws and azure;
- composition certification and the fail-closed Ed25519 verify floor (limitations 7-9 closed);
- the self-extend dial with disarm, and Fleet Phase 0 tenancy plumbing;
- SPEC-007 PRs 1-5 and the budgeted-autonomy controller PRs 1-5.

Autonomy is spike-grade and ships in hold mode (AshlarAutonomyOptions.cs:64). Its adversarial arcs run in cert-gate (AutonomyAdversarialCampaignTests.cs, 9 facts).

Not started:
- Forge: the IanFrelinger/Ashlar.Forge repo is empty and products/ was parked by #705.
- Forge.Verify, the public ledger repo, Cloud PAYG, Enterprise SSO and audit export, a versioned /v1 API, the GUI (#541), the Learning Harness (M7) and prompt certification.
- The launch, legal sign-off and customers.

The roadmap's own 0.2.0 launch target (:622) passed on 2026-10-01 without a re-baseline.

Critic correction: the M6.1 'no open P0 security findings' blocker list is the code-verified open set (#474, #478, #480, #483 partial, #492, #493 partial). #462, #463 and #488 are fixed on master and belong off that list.

No reader covered several areas. These are uncovered, not assessed:
- extensions/ashlar-vscode, infra/terraform/ashlar-sms-ingress, samples/aws-sns-ashlar-lambda and tools/devlog-ghost-publish have no CI and were last touched 2026-08-22.
- PrivateLicenseValidator.cs:86-97 accepts unsigned licenses when no HMAC secret is set, and signs with symmetric HMAC. The commercial/ tree has no license of its own.
areas.estimate: 5 of 41 exit criteria done, 10 partly built, 26 not started. The document ticks only 4. Against the product-boundary core list, 8 of 9 items are built.
areas.basis:
Each numbered M0.1-M7.8 exit checkbox in docs/audits/2026-09-completion-roadmap.md was checked against origin/master code and GitHub state. There are 41 boxes, 4 of them ticked (:75, :76, :177, :178), and the critic confirmed the count.
- Done: M0.1, M0.2, M1.1a, M1.1b, and M7.7 (DocsIndex.md:40 already links LearningHarness.md).
- Partly built: M0.4, M1.2, M1.3, M1.4, M2.1, M2.4, M3.4, M5.1, M5.3 and M7.1.
- Not started: everything else.
Of the product-boundary core list, the share and re-verify item is the one not yet met: it lacks the dogfood-dated E2E that #540 requires.
areas.blocker:
Owner decision on which end state governs, plus a re-baseline or a 'historical' mark for the completion roadmap. Downstream of that:
- Forge (M3-M4) is on HOLD and its repo is empty.
- M5 waits on the public-ledger scope (Option A or B).
- M6 needs legal, privacy and security sign-off, and customers.

areas.name: Autonomy unlock
areas.done_means:
Autonomy and design-partner marketing stay on HOLD until every criterion in docs/dogfood-scorecard.md:63-76 holds, counting only rows landed on master:
1. Scorecard thresholds met for 7 consecutive days: at least 80% PASS over the last 10 scheduled sweeps, mean time-to-admit of 15 minutes or less, a Strict rejection rate of 70% or less, and the 7-day streak itself.
2. Strict verification requires Ed25519.
3a. At least 7 rows citing a persisted, re-read, Strict-verified record.
3b. One attended pass signed by an operator key and pinned to that key alone.
4. A real hygiene PR produced by the loop and merged after human review.
The thresholds are still labelled 'Proposed defaults'. The Learning Harness claim also needs M1-M6 complete (roadmap :544-548 and :626-630, all unchecked; critic-corrected citation).
areas.status:

Master b130228ee is healthy where merges happen. The required checks are green (shell-lint runs on PRs only and is green on #783, which is built on this commit), and readiness is VERIFIED (run 38266204232). The budgeted-autonomy workstream has merged all five PRs and meets 34 of 36 card criteria. The PR 5 live run through Codex and Cursor is what remains, and only you can launch it. The wider project is far from its end states: 5 of 41 completion-roadmap exit criteria are done, 1 of 5 dogfood unlock criteria is met, and the next release has not started. This phase merged PR 5 (#781) and the pilot fixes (#780), and built the phase-end validation and audit (#783: CLEAN, not yet merged).

Validation on b130228eecf7: 4 pass, 3 warn, 0 fail, 0 error.
- Warn: 7 workflows end red on master. The validator counted 66 workflows, but 4 are deleted and one is Dependabot's; 61 files exist. compat-gate has been red since 2026-09-12 with no issue. The other six are dispatch-only and stale.
- Warn: secret scanning, push protection and Dependabot security updates are off on a public repository.
- Warn: local work on no remote. This phase's branch is now pushed. Of the 65 branches left, 53 bx/* hold the unlanded 2026-10-01 tech-debt backlog, and 12 are throwaway or already landed.

#### Moved since the last phase
First audit.

#### Critical path to the next release tag (number not chosen)
1. You: choose the version number.
2. You: decide whether the 160 unshipped Ashlar.Abstractions API lines ship as stable or [Experimental], as a dated SPEC-007 decisions-log row.
3. You: confirm or strike SPEC-007 rows 519-521, and answer Q-C (#766).
4. Fix the refusal masking BL4 and BL5 (PR 4.8b). This tag is the first to carry the AirGapped/SecureWorkstation enforce switch.
5. Fix compat-gate's stale tier B assertion (scripts/kernel-gate-tier-b.sh:80-84).
6. Land a records PR answering Grok's drift-746 and drift-748 asks.
7. You: classify the 11 open security defects and sign an exception for any that ships unfixed. Separately, close the 10 issues already fixed on master.
8. Re-run the dispatch-only RC gates on the release SHA.
9. Make the release commit, run the rc1 rehearsal, get VERIFIED on the release SHA, tag, and re-pin deploy/node.yml.
10. You: give the Product sign-off and provide an environment for a real rollback drill.

#### Hard dates
- 2026-10-01, passed: v0.2.0 shipped with the SPEC-006 S-4 dev-HMAC fallback still in place, and the roadmap's 0.2.0 launch target was missed without a re-baseline.
- 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-26: dogfood sweep-log artifacts expire daily.
- 2026-10-19: ubuntu-latest starts moving to 26.04; the next weekly readiness run.
- 2026-10-26: the artifacts of VERIFIED run 38266204232 expire.
- 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-11: the dogfood ledger-patch artifacts expire. After 2026-11-06, the existing runs can no longer supply 7 rows for 3a.
- 2026-11-10: .NET 8 end of support (Microsoft policy, recorded in no repo doc). 48 projects target net8.0 only.

- No dotnet tests or mutations ran. Counts and KILLED lines are quoted from PR bodies, the bus and reviews.
- Whether SPEC-007 rows 519-521 record your decisions.
- Per-layer readiness convergence: the ledger last converged on 2026-08-26.
